purpose: Re-screen representative H1-H11 strategy/search hypotheses under one current Tetrp authority and 200k corrected baseline before building a new sequential incumbent lineage.

candidates.prior_reason: Original fixed H3 finalist; represents the family without combining it with H1/H2.
Halving Quad-well shaping was the strongest repeatable H4 signal.
Old fresh validation winner before weak final confirmation.
Moderate old screening survivor; avoids using the extreme zero-height variant as the family representative.
Old screening leader, later 40-40 on fresh validation.
Old fixed H10 finalist, now retested at 200k.
Old preregistered structural primary k40s60, now integrated into current core and retested at 200k.

excluded_from_stage1.reason: Interaction experiment, not a standalone feature. Retest combo interaction only after relevant base features enter the new incumbent.
Joint attack x row-transition tuning. Preserve as interaction prior rather than pretending it is an independent feature.

sampling.game_a: candidate slot0/seed A vs incumbent slot1/seed B
sampling.game_b: incumbent slot0/seed A vs candidate slot1/seed B
sampling.rationale: Candidate and incumbent each receive both seeds and both slots within the pair, breaking deterministic same-seed mirror lock while controlling seed and slot assignment.
sampling.independence: Eight seed pairs are the experimental units. The 16 games are not 16 independent observations.
sampling.cross_candidate_note: All candidate families reuse the same eight seed pairs. Candidate-family results are correlated and must never be pooled as independent evidence.

screen_rule.screened_positive: candidate wins at least 11 of 16 games (equivalently net sweep advantage at least 3 pairs); advance to fresh confirmation.
screen_rule.screened_negative: candidate wins at most 5 of 16 games; stop spending compute for now, but preserve for retest triggers.
screen_rule.screened_neutral: candidate wins 6-10 of 16 games; no equivalence claim.
screen_rule.optional_extension: Neutral directional results 6-7 or 9-10 wins are eligible for a preregistered extension from 8 to 12 paired units before deciding whether confirmation is worthwhile. 8-8 is simply neutral.
screen_rule.paired_diagnostic: Report candidate sweeps, incumbent sweeps, split pairs, and an exact two-sided sign-test p value on non-split pairs. These diagnostics do not override the screen rule.
screen_rule.app_rule: Raw/sent APP are diagnostics only and cannot override KO.

failure_policy.cap_timeout_error: Unscored. Preserve structured failure, continue other pair games, and mark that candidate incomplete if 16 scored games are not available.

next_after_screen: Run the preregistered four-pair extension for H2/H4/H6/H6C/H9/H10, then freshly confirm only candidates reaching >=15/24 combined KO wins.

stage1_result.guard: APP pairs are [candidate, incumbent] and remain diagnostic only. No stage-1 candidate met the predeclared >=11/16 positive or <=5/16 negative threshold.

extension.selection_reason: Only positive-direction neutral stage-1 candidates receive immediate extra compute. Flat and negative-direction neutral families are archived, not permanently rejected.

combined_rule.screened_positive_after_extension: candidate wins >=15/24, equivalent to net candidate sweep advantage >=3 across 12 pairs
combined_rule.screened_negative_after_extension: candidate wins <=9/24, equivalent to net incumbent sweep advantage >=3 across 12 pairs
combined_rule.confirmation: Only screened-positive-after-extension candidates advance immediately to fresh confirmation.
combined_rule.app_rule: APP remains diagnostic only and cannot override KO.

extension.note: The extension rule is fixed before inspecting any 65016-65023 outcomes.
